messages:
deploy-bot: [ALERT] spike in 5xxs for /v1/generate in us-east-1. error rate ~18% over 60s. smart-routing observed lots of traffic falling back to cpu-small-quant variant. fallback pool CPU saturated.

alex (oncall): grabbing this. observed cascade? sounds like clients retrying and routing policy failing over to same fallback pool -> amplifier. first impact window started ~2412309800.

emily (prod): confirmed. p95 latency on fallback variant 2.4s -> impacts timeouts. top affected customers: fintech-app-1 (12% requests 5xx), analytics-saas (8%). token throughput to cpu-small-quant jumped x3 in 3m.

priya: paging. I’m awake, on my way. what’s the immediate ask?

alex (oncall): need quick mitigation: 1) stop automatic fallback to cpu-small-quant 2) throttle client retries at edge or return 429 for brief window 3) scale dedicated pool if possible.

ops-bot: triggered runbook "fallback-misroute-cascade" and created incident incident-2412309876. pagerduty: sent PD to @pri… :pager: 

alex (oncall): running quick check:
```
redwoodctl routing get --region us-east-1 --route /v1/generate
# shows fallback: cpu-small-quant, policy: immediate-failover
```

priya: plan: 1) disable fallback for /v1/generate in us-east-1 2) set short circuit-breaker to 200rps per-customer 3) push a temporary route to us-west-2 for non-sensitive traffic 4) ask product to notify top customers. doing steps 1+2 now.

alex (oncall): if we disable fallback we might increase tail latency for clients that depended on degraded fallback. tradeoff ok if reduces total 5xx. agree with routing to us-west-2.

priya: disabling fallback (one-liner):
```
redwoodctl routing patch --region us-east-1 --route /v1/generate --remove-fallback
# returns 202 accepted
```

ops-bot: rollback-safe change applied by priya at 2412310052.

emily (prod): enabling customer-level throttles on ingress for 10m window:
```
curl -X POST https://platform-api.internal/rate_limits \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" \ 
  -d '{"route":"/v1/generate","limit":200,"scope":"per_customer","window_s":60}'
```

alex (oncall): adding header to instruct SDKs to backoff gracefully: set `Retry-After` on 429 and bump 503 responses to include `x-rw-retry-suggestion: exponential`. can we flip now?

priya: done. 429s returning with Retry-After=5 for now. also enabled circuit-breaker (opens at 60% 5xx for 30s).

emily (prod): traffic towards cpu-small-quant pool dropped ~78% in last 90s. overall 5xx rate down to 6% cluster-wide. p50/p95 latencies improving.

alex (oncall): good. need to prevent clients from instant retrying and stomping new target region. how are clients behaving? any aggressive retry headers?

emily (prod): some clients have aggressive retry (backoff disabled) — sending notes to SDK team to publish recommended retry policy (jittered exponential).

priya: temporary policy pushed to routing control plane to prefer healthy variant in same region over fallback in global routing policy. command: 
```
redwoodctl policy update --name prefer-local-healthy --priority 50 --apply /v1/generate
```

ops-bot: policy apply returned OK at 2412310450.

alex (oncall): customer-impact check: cust-fintech-1 now at 3% 5xx, analytics-saas at 1.5%. overall token loss window estimate ~17k tokens/min for 4m. we should call top 2 customers?

emily (prod): yes. posting to status page + CSE ping for proactive outreach.

priya: handing off active mitigation to alex at 2412311200 — I need to jump to another incident meeting in 10m. notes: fallback removed, circuit-breaker enabled, rate-limits in place, policy prefer-local applied, watched traffic shift to us-west-2 for non-sensitive keys. will follow postmortem.

alex (oncall): taking over. will monitor for 30m then schedule postmortem. immediate next steps: 1) make routing change durable if stable, 2) run a canary traffic test to validate no regression in us-west-2, 3) ask client libraries to adopt Retry-After jitter.

emily (prod): updating status: partial degradation for some customers, mitigations applied. linking incident-2412309876 on status page. :clipboard:

alex (oncall): quick note for postmortem: root cause appears to be model-variant mislabeling during yesterday's rollout of cpu-small-quant; routing policy prioritized immediate fallback rather than gradual rollouts and lacked circuit-breaker tuned for retries. also clients with aggressive retry behavior amplified traffic.

ops-bot: incident severity downgraded to S2 at 2412312000. monitoring continues.

alex (oncall): thanks everyone. handing back to oncall rotation and will own postmortem doc. :thumbsup:

priya: FYI will open infra PR to add a safety-net: limit fallback fanout to N regions and add token-bucket limit per-variant to avoid cascade.

emily (prod): filing customer comm draft now.

pagerduty: incident-2412309876 closed for active paging at 2412312345.

alex (oncall): postmortem owners: alex + priya + emily. timeline + remediation plan will be posted in ~24h.
